title: The Big Bang Theory
text: The Big Bang theory is the prevailing cosmological model explaining the origin of the universe. It posits that the universe began as an extremely hot and dense point approximately 13.8 billion years ago and has been expanding and cooling ever since. Evidence supporting the Big Bang includes the cosmic microwave background (CMB) radiation — a faint glow of radiation permeating all of space — discovered by Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson in 1965. The redshift of distant galaxies, first observed by Edwin Hubble in 1929, also indicates an expanding universe. The first few minutes after the Big Bang produced hydrogen, helium, and lithium through Big Bang nucleosynthesis.
